paper.title_en: Finite N Black Holes through the Brick Wall
paper.abstract_en: In AdS/CFT at finite $N$, black holes are described by ordinary quantum systems with finite entropy and discrete spectra, while semiclassical bulk effective field theory treats the near-horizon region as an ideal continuum. We reconsider the brick-wall model as a simple effective description of the finite $N$ departure from the semiclassical near-horizon continuum in AdS/CFT. A Dirichlet wall is reflecting; however, once the regulated near-wall modes are replaced by interacting stretched-horizon degrees of freedom, the exterior simple sector can look absorptive and black-hole-like. If these degrees of freedom are thermally populated while the exterior incoming modes are in their vacuum, they radiate as ordinary hot matter, and this gives Hawking radiation. Furthermore, we show that finite $N$ prevents the near-horizon sector from being an ideal continuum absorber; the brick-wall model is a simple effective representation of this limitation, where the failure of perfect absorption appears as residual reflection or echoes. Such return effects appear on the echo time scale $κ^{-1}\log S_{\rm BH}$ and are not expected to be suppressed as $e^{-S_{\rm BH}}$, although their detailed amplitude is model-dependent. We also discuss brick-wall-like models in which the effective inner boundary arises dynamically from a regular matter core rather than from an imposed boundary condition.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在AdS/CFT有限N框架下重新审视brick-wall模型，讨论视界附近连续极限的失效、Hawking辐射的产生机制以及回声/残余反射效应，并涉及动力学内边界模型，理论深度较高且议题与黑洞热力学及全息方向密切相关，值得进一步阅读。摘要为概念性论述，未给出定量推导细节，方法学与新颖性信号为中等。
decision.title_zh: 通过砖墙模型的有限N黑洞
decision.abstract_zh: 在有限$N$的AdS/CFT中，黑洞由具有有限熵和离散谱的普通量子系统描述，而半经典体有效场论则将近视界区域视为理想连续体。我们重新考虑砖墙模型，将其作为AdS/CFT中有限$N$偏离半经典近视界连续体的一种简单有效描述。Dirichlet墙是反射性的；然而，一旦受调控的近墙模式被替换为相互作用的拉伸视界自由度，外部的简单扇区就可以显得具有吸收性并类似黑洞。如果这些自由度被热占据，而外部入射模式处于其真空态，它们就会像普通热物质一样辐射，这给出Hawking辐射。此外，我们表明有限$N$阻止近视界扇区成为理想的连续吸收体；砖墙模型是这一限制的一种简单有效表示，其中完全吸收的失败表现为残余反射或回声。这类返回效应出现在回声时间尺度$κ^{-1}\log S_{\rm BH}$上，并且预期不会被$e^{-S_{\rm BH}}$所压低，尽管其具体振幅依赖于模型。我们还讨论了这样的类砖墙模型：其中有效内边界是由规则的物质核心动力学地产生的，而不是由强加的边界条件产生的。
